cases.prompt: How is this job done?
cases.response: Under SOP-IC-11, the well is first killed with approved brine, production tubing pulled, and a drillable cement retainer set and pressure-tested above the wet perforations. An injection test is then performed before pumping cement slurry into the channelled interval using hesitation cycles until final squeeze pressure holds steadily. After reverse-circulating excess slurry and curing, the cement is drilled out and pressure-tested for hydraulic isolation, followed by reperforation of the prospective oil zone and completion rerun.
